thread:
ana: New hire hit multiple problems in the deploy walkthrough for samples/voice. README curl/JS snippets out of date.
tom: details? paste what failed.
rana: (typo, should be ana) oops
ana: here: curl uses ENV_NAME=REDWOOD_KEY_OLD and posts to https://api.redwood-inference.example/v1/stream -> 404. Also JS import uses `import Redwood from '@redwood/inference'` and the sample shows `retry: 2` which is ambiguous.
ravi: ah yeah, we've changed env var names and base URL some time back. That explains the 404.
cli-bot: automated link-checker: Broken link detected in README: ./examples/stream/index.mjs -> 404 (reported 2026-03-20T10:12:23Z)
tom: PR to fix? can we include a brief note explaining that retry settings differ by SDK (JS uses jittered exponential backoff, python uses fixed backoff unless configured)? we should avoid saying "parity" in README.
nana: i'm opening a small PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/samples/pull/4310 title: "fix(samples): update curl env + imports, clarify retry defaults"
ravi: nice. also please replace any mentions of node-fetch with undici and set package.json "type":"module" for the example starter.
nana: done in the PR. added a one-liner under "Troubleshooting": "If the sample fails with 401, verify your env var is REDWOOD_API_KEY and you're using the correct region endpoint (see /docs/regions.md)".
tom: can we add a `samples-smoke` workflow that runs the JS example in CI? tiny step: `npm ci && node examples/voice/index.mjs` so that broken imports or node-fetch issues fail fast.
nana: added workflow as non-blocking in a separate commit in the PR.
docs-bot: PR opened by ana: https://github.com/redwood-inference/samples/pull/4310 :sparkles:
cli-bot: link-check passed on updated README (2026-03-20T10:45:01Z)
ravi: small follow-up: let's add a PR checklist item to samples/CONTRIBUTING.md: "update sample run instructions and verify env var names and package imports". keeps copy/paste drift from happening.
tom: agree. also file a short issue to track multi-sdk retry docs so we can add a table later: #1020.
nana: filed #1020 and assigned to eng-docs.
tom: thanks all. i'll merge after CI green. :white_check_mark:
